bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$root"
git fetch -q origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111
rev=460f43427f7137345923187e85da12011f0ca986
test -n "$(git rev-parse "$rev")"
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/userbot-ipc-static-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
for name in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py test_userbot_resident_ipc.py; do git show "$rev:scripts/$name" > "$tmp/$name"; done
python3 -B -m py_compile "$tmp/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" "$tmp/test_userbot_resident_ipc.py"
cd "$tmp"
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m unittest -q test_userbot_resident_ipc
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 81
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 82
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session" || exit 83
test "$(stat -c %a "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 84
echo USERBOT_IPC_SOURCE_TEST=PASS
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_UNIT_UNTOUCHED=ACTIVE
echo USERBOT_IPC_RUNTIME=NOT_ACTIVATED
